target.title: fix(ios): defer QR pairing after scanner dismissal
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #99571.

Fixes an issue where iOS users scanning a gateway pairing QR could have the scanner dismiss at the wrong time, lose the trust/approval handoff, or crash while VisionKit was still stopping camera capture.

The affected surfaces are the iOS onboarding scanner, Gateway Settings scanner, app/open-url setup-link handling, and post-scan gateway approval handoff.

## Why This Change Was Made

The scanner now stops VisionKit scanning, queues one typed QR/setup result, dismisses the scanner sheet, and processes pairing only from the sheet dismissal path after a short main-actor settling delay. The final branch also handles setup links delivered during app/onboarding launch by staging UIKit app-delegate URLs through the same gateway setup-link path used by SwiftUI `.onOpenURL`.

This keeps the scanner lifecycle separate from gateway trust UI and avoids re-entering the onboarding/settings presentation stack while VisionKit is still dismissing.

## User Impact

iOS users can pair a gateway by scanning a QR code from onboarding or from Settings without losing the approval flow. After approval, the app reaches Chat and can send/receive messages immediately.

## Evidence

- Reproduced the original crash on Polly's iPhone with current-main proof build `2026.6.11 / 488`.
- Crash log: `OpenClaw-2026-07-03-160229.ips`, app bundle `ai.openclawfoundation.app.test.pollybot-5y97h9j837`.
- Crash signature: `EXC_CRASH` / `SIGABRT`, `+[UIAlertController _alertControllerContainedInViewController:]`, with VisionKit stopping `AVCaptureSession` on `com.apple.visionkit.avcapturequeue`.
- Current-head physical iPhone proof on exact PR head `11583731daa4a73d52b8a473f0f75b6636f749e4`, app build `2026.6.11 / 63927`, gateway/CLI `2026.6.11`.
- Onboarding QR flow: fresh app install/reset, QR scan, gateway approval, node/operator pairing, Chat available, immediate test message delivered.
- Settings QR flow: app reset, Settings-page QR scan, gateway approval, node/operator pairing, Chat available, immediate test message delivered.
- Redacted physical proof bundle: https://github.com/PollyBot13/openclaw/blob/proof/pr-99572-qrscanner-dismissal/pr-99572-qrscanner-dismissal/README.md
- Raw onboarding proof video: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PollyBot13/openclaw/refs/heads/proof/pr-99572-qrscanner-dismissal/pr-99572-qrscanner-dismissal/pr99572-onboarding-qr-redacted.mp4
- Raw Settings proof video: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PollyBot13/openclaw/refs/heads/proof/pr-99572-qrscanner-dismissal/pr-99572-qrscanner-dismissal/pr99572-settings-qr-redacted.mp4
- Drive mirror: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ZcrBf-bKsou8AnYu5MyKO9ywfAe0XKqY
- Redactions mask QR/setup-code frames, gateway address/domain fields, trust/detail popups, and transient setup views. The setup bootstrap tokens were consumed by successful pairing, but setup details are still masked for public review.
- `openclaw devices list` after proof showed the iPhone paired with both node and operator scopes and no pending approval request.
- Current hosted CI for head `11583731daa4a73d52b8a473f0f75b6636f749e4` is green; `mergeStateStatus` is `CLEAN`.

Local validation:

- `git diff --check`
- `pnpm native:i18n:check`
- Focused iOS source-guard tests: 35 passed
- Maintainer exact-head simulator proof: 35 `RootTabsSourceGuardTests` passed on iPhone 17 / iOS 26.5, including callback-order guards for both scanner owners and stop-before-delivery.
- Maintainer autoreview: clean after one accepted test-specificity finding was repaired.

AI-assisted: yes.
